audit._comment_anchor: OPT-IN WORM anchoring (ADR-012). Rename to "anchor" + create the bucket with Object Lock COMPLIANCE retention (see docs/runbooks/audit-anchoring.md). Tamper-resistance is CONDITIONAL on Object Lock + restricted IAM.

_comment_model_fallbacks: OPT-IN model-level fallback (D5): a client hardcoding a not-yet-configured model name (e.g. a new Claude release) is served a configured model instead of 404ing, until you add a real route. Default (no config needed) is the same-family heuristic: an unrouted "claude-opus-5" would already fall back to the highest configured "claude-opus-*" version below it (here, claude-opus-4-8) with model_fallbacks entirely absent. The explicit map below only matters for a DIFFERENT-family redirect, or to override the heuristic's pick; one hop only, target must be a configured model or alias. Set model_fallback_family: false to disable the heuristic outright.
_comment_plugins: OPT-IN PII masking (ADR-009). WARNING: masking re-serializes the request body, abandoning verbatim forwarding, so prompt-cache hits are LOST for masked teams (up to ~10x cost). Omit Teams for global. Masked teams are rejected on the OpenAI-compatible endpoint in v1. Uncomment to enable:
_comment_otel: OPT-IN OpenTelemetry tracing (ADR-011). Exports OTLP spans (GenAI semconv) to your own collector; no-op when absent. protocol http|grpc; sample_ratio omitted = 1.0, explicit 0.0 = none. Rename to "otel" to enable:
